thread:
Anya Gomez: quick brainstorm 1: can we surface preview results in a dedicated 'safety' dashboard before a config promotion? saw a promo yesterday that widened route scope but didn't show per-route quota impact.
Ravi Singh: yes please. need per-route token delta + top-five affected customers. also want recent error spikes aggregated by route.
Parker James: +1. UX idea: a small heatmap (routes x metrics) + a detail pane with sample traces. red = >threshold regression.
Anya Gomez: good. backend notes: preview API already returns coverage and est_token_delta for overall config. we need to extend it to return per-route breakdown and any matched quota sets.
Ravi Singh: API proposal: GET /api/v1/configs/{id}/preview?scope=routes&seed=XYZ. returns list of {route, coverage, est_tokens_hr, p95_delta, error_ratio}. include sampling_seed for reproducibility.
Parker James: also include retention metadata: how long the preview snapshot is valid. we should show the TTL in the dashboard.
CI-Bot: triggered preview-run 2860012345 by @Anya Gomez 1: queued -> running. artifacts will be uploaded to s3://previews/2860012345/
Anya Gomez: operational constraints: runtime preview shouldn't flood frontends. cap to 1% of traffic or 500rps whichever smaller. sample deterministically via hash so repeated previews are comparable.
Ravi Singh: telemetry gating rules draft: block promotion if any route p95_delta > 15% OR any route error_ratio > 2 across lookback 6h. also warn if est_token_delta > $50/hr.
Parker James: dashboards: show three panels per-route: coverage, p95_delta, est_tokens_per_hour. add a 'safety score' computed as weighted sum: 0.5*norm(p95_delta)+0.3*norm(error_ratio)+0.2*norm(cost_delta).
Helix: note: safety score model needs explainability. include link to computation and weights in modal.
Anya Gomez: prod flow idea: when user clicks Promote -> open Safety Modal with quick summary (approx coverage + validated coverage if available) and a small graph. if gate trips, disable Promote and show reason. allow force-promote with two-step ack + explaining risk (and require JIRA/PR link).
Ravi Singh: audit: log preview_artifact_id, sample_seed, thresholds_used, who forced promotion, and a short text reason. store entries for 90 days.
Parker James: implementation path: (1) extend preview API to return per-route details and artifact id, (2) add background validator job that runs runtime-validated sampling and writes back validated_coverage + telemetry deltas, (3) build safety dashboard UI + modal in console.
Anya Gomez: timeframes: can we have a minimal prototype (API + modal stub) in staging in 2 weeks?
Ravi Singh: I can ship the API + validator job in 10 days. Parker, can you own the modal and dashboard?
Parker James: yep. will mock up wireframes today.
CI-Bot: preview-run 2860012345 status: completed. artifact: https://ci.internal/previews/2860012345/summary.json
Anya Gomez: sample of API call for teams who want to wire into CI:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.internal/v1/configs/CFG-123/preview" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{
  "sample_fraction": 0.01,
  "seed": "cohort-42",
  "lookback_hours": 6,
  "include_routes": true
}'
```
Ravi Singh: good to include sample_fraction and seed. also return a field "estimated_cost_24h" so billing team isn't surprised.
Parker James: UX Q: show both "fast estimate" (console-side hashing) and "validated" (runtime sample) with timestamps. validated can say "pending" until job completes.
Anya Gomez: edge-case: what if validated coverage < fast_estimate? that's fine. but if validated > fast_estimate significantly, we should flag as risky and recommend rollback of recent related promos.
Ravi Singh: CI integration: add a Jenkins/CI step that fails pipeline when safety gate trips unless override flag set. default override needs 2 approvers for safety.
Parker James: note for console: include a "Compare to baseline" toggle to show delta vs currently deployed config. makes regressions easier to spot.
Helix: ops note: retention for preview logs should be 7 days for traces, 90 days for summary metrics. fine to drop raw traces after 7d.
Anya Gomez: fine. follow-ups: Ravi will draft gating thresholds and validator caps, Parker will post mocks, I'll update the API RFC with artifact schema. We'll sync end-of-week. :thumbsup:
